info.name: ExpressHub API
info.description: All implemented API routes. Set baseUrl (origin only), email and password in collection variables or an optional environment. See README.md for the workflow. Authentication saves tokens; shipment creation saves shipmentId; Checkout saves paymentId and checkoutUrl. Set userId and courierId explicitly before targeted operations. Stripe webhooks require genuine signed provider events. Send mutations individually. Run the Role access checks folder after logging in all three roles. Saved examples are illustrative.

request.description: Provider-only endpoint; no bearer token. Requires original signed JSON body (maximum 256 KiB), valid recent signature and matching account/mode. Server verifies payment metadata, amount and currency against Stripe. Duplicate events are acknowledged without repeating changes; unrelated events are ignored. A 503 requests a retry. Send real signed events through Stripe CLI; the Postman reference body alone cannot simulate a valid payment.
